entries.decision: Delivery source stores parent→child; agriculture/city/network store child→parent. Preserve endpoints, map to has_argument/argument_of and verify AST order. Source bytes remain unchanged.

entries.topic: Runtime command spelling overlaps definition family
entries.decision: Runtime command, command_instance and command_attempt map to command_attempt only in runtime namespace. Frozen commands stay command_definition.

entries.topic: Predicate expected truth vs evaluated result
entries.decision: Raw runtime predicate_result becomes predicate_expectation. Frozen predicate_results remains predicate_result with execution provenance. Neither may gain native-executed status.

entries.topic: Generic INSTANCE_OF signature was too broad
entries.decision: Meta-type classification is classified_as, fact→field is instantiates_state, expression→expression_type is expression_kind_of. Instance/definition family compatibility is checked separately.
Preserve both window_s and duration_seconds when present, all control values and absence. No alias precedence or native temporal interpretation is invented.

entries.topic: Missing native Atlas source and evaluator
entries.decision: The exact full catalog, operator registry, rule IDs, grammar and native round-trip/evaluation parity remain unverified. Source AST preservation is still testable.

entries.topic: Legacy capability declarations mix templates and claims
entries.decision: Use capability_declaration for frozen family and preserve semantic_level. Explicit runtime capability_claim remains distinct. Authored claim scope does not prove a reusable verified capability or authority.
check_binding preserves original scope and not_admission. Start, continue, effect_confirmation and review checks cannot be substituted for each other.

entries.topic: Collection name inside city node-type record
entries.decision: Actual enclosing collections.node_types determines node_type. Internal collection denotes represented family and remains unchanged in payload.

entries.topic: Resource and control cardinality depends on role
entries.decision: No blanket one-per-node degree constraint. Exact attempt/binding/role/interval defines local cardinality; parallel operations and repeated receipts remain possible.
Synthetic grants, legal placeholders and engineering thresholds are retained as source examples, never a verified real permission or legal rule.

entries.topic: Graph canonical ID vs structured lifecycle Ref
entries.decision: Storage IDs do not repair or replace missing lifecycle members. Preserve typed epoch/generation and source precision.
Matching name or type is insufficient. Require explicit same namespace/id/revision/scope and exact semantic body. Missing revision blocks semantic cross-source merge.
source_field_reference preserves exact source field/path/index. It cannot imply authority, causal execution, legal applicability or physical effect.
rule_evaluation_binding is compatible with evaluation_binding, but result_ref is a lineage reference, not evidence that native evaluation occurred.
command_lifecycle_receipt contains an ordered state sequence. It stays separate from command_receipt; neither proves task completion.
A transformation references a relation schema via conforms_to_transformation_relation; it is not cast into a generic physical custody relation instance.

entries.topic: Legacy emergency check field labelled INSTANCE_OF
entries.decision: Network source extraction contains 42 check_binding→state_specification state_field references labelled INSTANCE_OF. Retain endpoints and source payload, map only that precise role/signature to legacy_field_reference; never a type cast.
Literal is_null describes JSON structure only. Unknown truth and missing/unavailable evidence require explicit semantic statuses; neither null, false nor zero may substitute for one another.

The 27 network authority_record entries explicitly have definition level and real_authority=false. Retain their declared level; they are scoped authorization declarations, not observed grants. Runtime authority records remain independently typed by semantic_level.
Source D02 link_configuration is preserved as source-record configuration, not coerced into a link entity or observed link fact.
No clock mapping, commit cutoff, freshness, interpolation or future-evidence admission is fabricated. Explicit unavailable diagnostics block execution readiness.
